question: Identify the figure in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76033a42a5d05f66561e5e64ea3ff2ccc1547fb80be68ae3b082f40ad5b0503c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) For the left top number series → (2) is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20d444da9f3580d26e62dcee386e5cb6af2bd9f6aaece6cfb57f240fcf3d5317.png] 

2) For the left bottom corner number series → (2) is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32e9e439574535784ca7353d96c7ad7c13e00600968b38fb1314e654ba33d38c.png] 

3) For the right corner number series → (4) is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9137d4d6144d550ebac84ea33b417ff0d5b13ca09f16a93043d727c316ae401b.png] 

4) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d93357053da2fa928de8564e060073587dabb0dd9ce1551b2ac1db108ab4664.png] ' element → No change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1ac52badfe6566b382e0744c8889c259a95405638709efccced5c318627c26e.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f8d5bd45ca4008702b8ff2d3208cf6fde0c75267524b105a3027b1ecda0339.png] 

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
